description_en: Queries the number of days that Security Center retains vulnerabilities before automatic deletion
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoDelConfig接口查询自动删除漏洞前的漏洞的保存天数
name: DescribeAutoDelConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Days.description_en: The number of days that Security Center retains vulnerabilities before automatic deletion
Days.description_zh: 在自动删除漏洞前云安全中心保存漏洞的天数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
